verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe the core loop directly: you give a natural-language goal plus a starting URL, and Skyvern navigates unseen sites, fills forms, and completes multi-step tasks via API (skyvern-docs-18, skyvern-docs-17, skyvern-gh-1), with concrete use cases like auto-filling and submitting job applications (skyvern-docs-14, skyvern-docs-15). Hands-on community testing confirms it works on the Geico happy path but failed partway through a costcotravel.com flow, entering a location and then not clicking the popup (skyvern-comm-2). That is a reliability limit rather than a contradiction of the capability. Missing for 10: independent evidence of reliable end-to-end completion on complex or dynamic flows (popups, tabs), and broader hands-on corroboration beyond happy-path demos.
